001: Sato-san, were you able to check the email I sent a little while ago?
Yes, I checked it. I understood the contents well.
Then, could you send me a reply by tomorrow morning?
Understood. I will reply first thing tomorrow morning.
002: Tanaka-san, could you forward this document to the relevant people?
Understood. I will forward it to the relevant people within the company.
Also, please put "Urgent Confirmation" in the subject line.
Got it. I will send it with "Urgent Confirmation" in the subject.
That helps a lot. Please let me know if you get any replies.
Yes, I will contact you as soon as I receive a reply.
003: Were you able to open the attachment on the email I sent earlier?
No, I haven't checked it yet. I will try opening it now.
If you can't open it, please let me know as soon as possible.
It's fine, I was able to open it successfully. I also checked the contents.
Then, could you give me your opinion on the contents?
Yes, I will think about it a bit and then reply by email.
004: We haven't replied to the inquiry email from the customer yet.
Is that so? When did the email arrive?
It arrived yesterday evening, but our reply is delayed.
That's not good. You should reply right away.
You're right. I will reply right now.
I will also check the contents and add anything if needed.
005: Could you share the meeting minutes by email?
Yes, I will share them by the end of today. What file format would you like?
Please send it in Word as well, along with the PowerPoint materials.
Understood. I will send it in both formats.
Also, please send it to everyone involved.
Yes, I will send it to all the participants.
006: Aren't the recipients on this email wrong?
Oh, you're right. One of the recipients is wrong.
Please resend it to the correct recipients immediately.
I am so sorry. I will resend it right away.
Please make sure to double-check the recipients before sending from now on.
Yes, I will be careful from now on. I apologize for the trouble.
007: I would like to send an email regarding the new project.
Sure. Who are you planning to send it to?
I will send it to Suzuki-san from the sales department and Takahashi-san from the development department.
Got it. Could you also CC me on it?
Of course. I will send it with you on CC as well.
Thank you. I will also review the contents.
008: I still haven't received a reply to the email I sent last week.
Is that so? Shall we check with the other party?
Please do. I need a reply urgently, so please check on it.
Understood. I will try calling them right now to confirm.
Thank you. Please let me know if you find out anything.
Yes, I will contact you as soon as I get confirmation.
009: Could I get some advice on how to write emails?
Sure. What kind of email is it?
It's an email to notify a customer about a change in the delivery date.
I see. It would be good to include an apology and clearly state the new delivery date.
Thank you. I will try rewriting it that way.
Once you rewrite it, please let me check it too.
010: Could you check this email once before I send it?
Sure. I will take a look right now.
In particular, I'd like you to check if the honorific language is correct.
Understood. Let me take a look. There are a few spots that might be better with some adjustments.
Is that so? Where should I fix it?
For this sentence, I think "ご確認ください" would sound more natural.
